name: web-mirror
description: Rust command line tool and library that mirrors a section of a website to disk, like `wget --mirror`, with safe defaults.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR BSD-3-Clause

examples.result: The A–Z page and every page linked from its main content.
A copy to browse offline: pages, stylesheets, images, scripts, with links rewritten to local files.
Only the PDFs below the start URL; pages are crawled but not saved.
Refresh a mirror, downloading only pages changed on the server (Last-Modified and ETag).
Also archive every page and requisite in crawl.warc.gz (WARC 1.1) with a crawl.cdx index.
Check links without saving; log why URLs were skipped.
Check every link, including links to other sites (public addresses only), and report broken ones with the pages that link to them.

defaults: Never goes above the start URL
Never downloads a file twice (existing files are read for links)
Resumes an interrupted crawl from .web-mirror/state.jsonl (--fresh starts over)
Follows URLs in HTML and CSS only (JavaScript with --follow-js)
One request at a time (--max-connections for parallel, still one per host)
At most 20 redirects, only within the start URLs' sites

commands.audit: cargo audit && cargo deny check advisories

planned: continuous: fuzzing and property tests for path mapping and parsers
continuous: CI on Linux, macOS, Windows
